description: Prefer offer_quest for solo work: it saves the exact draft you present, records the person's own choice, and accept assigns that draft atomically. Reach for this tool when the offer tools are unavailable, or when they have already accepted a concrete task in conversation. Create an assignment only after the person explicitly accepts the concrete task offered in conversation. Offer its scope and evidence requirement first, then wait. Smaller or different means revise and ask again; not now, silence, or interest in a topic is not acceptance. This call immediately creates an attempt, not an offer. Deliver a quest you authored for one of the person's curiosities that already has a topic (check get_profile_context, or call propose_interest first — it takes effect immediately). Write it in their voice: a concrete, doable task with a clear objective, 1–10 steps, and what evidence counts. quest_type is one of teach_back, bridge_finder, source_quest, field_report. There is no human review step anywhere in this flow.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.

name: store_quest
title: Save a Solo Assignment
